headline: Jett Returns to Jadolf Hurtler
body: After sitting out 2025, Jett rejoins the league for the 2026 season — Jadolf Hurtler is back.

headline: Brock Claims First Championship
body: Piesman Fan Club takes down the field to win the 2025 title — Brock's first crown after nine seasons in the league.

headline: Tommy Joins the League
body: CeeDeezNutz enters Ballreich's Premier League, taking the league to a full twelve teams.

headline: The League Goes to ESPN
body: Ballreich's Premier League moves to ESPN for its first tracked season — the record book starts here.
